findings.description: Every row's Edit link and Delete button has the same generic name ("Edit" / "Delete") with no aria-label or hidden row context, so screen-reader users navigating by links or buttons cannot tell which expense each action affects.
repro: Sign in as editor-868f at 1280 px.
List links or buttons with a screen reader or accessibility tree: eight 'Edit' links and eight 'Delete' buttons with identical names.

findings.description: Amounts of $1000 or more are shown without a thousands separator (for example "$1234.56" in the row and "Total: $1634.55"), which is inconsistent with standard currency formatting.
repro: Sign in as editor-868f at 1920 px.
Open /expenses/new, enter title 'QA probe', category office, amount 1234.56, click Save.
On the list, the row shows $1234.56 and the total shows Total: $1634.55 with no comma separators.

notes: Tested at 1280, 1920 and 360 px as viewer and editor, with mouse and keyboard focus. Checked sign-in, list totals, category filter (travel total 185.25 correct), add and edit forms, save round trip, viewer 403 on /expenses/new and /expenses/1/edit, phone layout without horizontal overflow, and focus ring visibility (3px solid outline). Totals matched row sums everywhere. Side effects on the shared data: a probe expense 'QA probe' ($1234.56, office) was added, and expense 3 was re-saved with its unchanged amount. Not tested: Delete actions (destructive), touch-specific gestures, and automated contrast or axe scans.

cost.notes: estimate from 28376 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0034
